items.item: Implement and verify source/estimand/power construction for the fourteen GO routes without opening literature outcomes.

Release rep-010 only after its component reproductions have separately completed and been verified.

Do not allocate genuinely unexposed future confirmation observations to the narrower frozen rep-021 mapping unless a later explicit research decision retains that mapping as independently worthwhile; existing Programme-002 sealed windows remain unopened.

Any revised scored one-month target/horizon/model mapping must use a new research identity after feasibility is established; do not adapt rep-021 features, target semantics, baseline, predictor timing or thresholds post hoc.

Before any new scoring, perform an unscored data-and-capacity feasibility assessment for #348's intended target-matched diagnostic: calendar-average target/delivery semantics, market/futures calibration history, realized target-period physical inputs, matching PIT inputs, programme-wide outcome exposure, and detectability of the 1% material-effect threshold under plausible dependence.
